en.name: Soy milk
en.summary: Soy milk is soaked soybeans ground with water, cooked and strained — a suspension of soy protein and oil rather than a starch drink. It is sold chilled or in shelf-stable cartons. Follow the use-by date on an unopened pack, and once it is opened use it within 7–10 days, refrigerated.
en.pantry: An unopened aseptic carton sits in a cupboard to its printed date, having been sterilised and filled sealed. A chilled carton has to stay cold, under the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour when the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Neither goes back in a cupboard once opened. Freshly made soy milk — from a breakfast shop, or a home soy milk machine — is a third case and much shorter-lived: warm, low in acid, rich in protein and with nothing added to preserve it, it sours in a few hours at room temperature. Chill it fast in a shallow container rather than a tall jug, and drink it the same day.
en.fridge: 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on an inside shelf rather than the door. Unopened chilled cartons run to their printed date; opened, 7–10 days with the cap closed. Two normal things worry people. Soy milk separates on standing, and it forms a skin when heated — in the same way dairy milk does and for the same reason, protein coagulating at the surface. Neither is spoilage; shake it and carry on. Nor is curdling in coffee: the acidity and heat of the coffee destabilise the soy protein, which is why a barista adds it to cooler coffee, and a split latte says nothing at all about the carton. Actual spoilage is a sour smell with a thickened, slippery texture that stays after shaking.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is published for soy milk, and freezing breaks the suspension: the protein and the oil come out of it, and the thawed drink is watery with grainy flecks that shaking will not redissolve. If you must, freeze at −18 °C (0 °F) leaving headspace, and use it in baking, a sauce or a smoothie, where the texture gets beaten back in. Better still, buy the size you will drink, or make a smaller batch.
en.thawing: Fridge, never counter, and then blend it rather than merely shaking — a blender gets more of the protein back into suspension than a wrist will. Use it in cooking rather than drinking it neat, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: A sour, sharp or yeasty smell instead of a clean beany one.
Lumps or curdled strands in the carton that do not shake out.
A swollen carton, or a fizz and hiss on opening.
A slimy, ropy pour, or mould around the spout.
tips: Write the opening date on the carton.
Shake before every pour; separation and a skin are normal.
Never drink from the carton if you are keeping the rest.
Drink freshly made soy milk the same day and chill it fast.

faq.q: How long does soy milk last after opening?
faq.a: About 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept closed and upright.

faq.q: Does soy milk need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Chilled cartons do, and unopened ones go by the use-by date. Aseptic shelf-stable cartons can stay in the cupboard until opened.
There is no established timeline. It separates badly, so freeze it only for cooking or baking, at −18 °C with headspace in the container.

faq.q: Why does soy milk curdle in coffee?
faq.a: The acidity and heat of the coffee destabilise the soy protein. It is a chemistry problem, not a sign that the milk has gone off.

zh.name: 豆漿
zh.summary: 豆漿是黃豆泡軟後加水磨碎、煮熟過濾而成——它是大豆蛋白和油脂的懸浮液，不是澱粉飲料。市面上有冷藏與常溫利樂包兩種。未開封以包裝上的有效日期為準；開封後冷藏，請在 7～10 天內喝完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的無菌利樂包經過滅菌並密封充填，可以放櫥櫃到標示日期。冷藏包裝必須保冷，適用 2 小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。兩種開封後都不回櫥櫃。現做的豆漿——早餐店的，或家用豆漿機打的——是第三種情況，也短命得多：溫熱、低酸、蛋白質豐富，而且完全沒有添加任何保存成分，在室溫下幾個小時就發酸。請用淺容器而不是深壺快速降溫，並且當天喝完。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下的內側層架，不要放門邊。未開封的冷藏包裝以盒上日期為準；開封後蓋緊，7～10 天。有兩件正常的事常讓人擔心。豆漿靜置會分層，加熱後表面會結一層皮——和牛奶結皮是同一回事，都是蛋白質在表面凝聚——兩者都不是變質，搖一搖繼續用就好。在咖啡裡結絮也一樣：是咖啡的酸度和溫度讓大豆蛋白失去穩定，所以咖啡師會把它加進溫度較低的咖啡裡，而一杯結絮的拿鐵完全說明不了那盒豆漿的狀況。真正的變質是聞起來發酸，而且質地變稠、變滑，搖過也不會回復。
zh.freezer: 豆漿沒有公布的冷凍期限，而冷凍會直接破壞那個懸浮狀態：蛋白質和油脂被逼出來，解凍後又水又帶著顆粒，搖也搖不回去。真的要凍，放 −18 °C、容器留膨脹空間，之後用在烘焙、醬汁或果昔這類會被重新攪打的地方。更好的做法是買喝得完的容量，或一次少做一點。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面，之後請用調理機打過，不要只用手搖——機器比手腕更能把蛋白質重新打回懸浮。建議拿去料理，不要直接喝，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有酵母味，而不是乾淨的豆香。
盒內出現搖不散的結塊或凝絮。
包裝鼓脹，或開封時冒泡、有嘶聲。
倒出來黏稠牽絲，或吸嘴周圍長霉。
tips: 每次倒之前搖一搖；分層和結皮都是正常的。
還要留著喝的話，不要直接對著盒口喝。
現做豆漿請快速降溫並當天喝完。

faq.q: 豆漿開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊直立放 4 °C 以下，大約 7～10 天。
冷藏包裝一定要，未開封以有效日期為準。無菌常溫利樂包在開封前可放櫥櫃。
沒有既定期限。它分離得厲害，只建議冷凍後用於料理或烘焙，放 −18 °C 並留膨脹空間。

faq.q: 豆漿加咖啡為什麼會結絮？
faq.a: 咖啡的酸度和溫度讓大豆蛋白失去穩定。那是化學問題，不代表豆漿壞掉。
